weightings: The census weights each connected representation up to renaming once. The draws are the recorded 300 accepted labelled starts per size, with replacement.

reader definitions.all listed supports: The frozen single-knot reading treats every listed support as available.
reader definitions.only supports passing K1\u2013K3: Only listed supports whose full allowed-state image is their parity knot can read a carrier.
reader definitions.complete split: At least three distinction-disjoint simple cycles with nonconstant, invariant, individually unread parities, whose sum is forced.
reader definitions.minimal split: A complete split of m cycles with joint image of rank m-1. Every proper subfamily is free.
reader definitions.new at this growth: The minimal split's total parity was not forced by the preceding stage on these same distinctions. Every fresh distinction still has one holder in its birth round.
reader definitions.outside start laws: A forced sum outside the span of start equations. Some distinctions carrying it can have been born after the start.
reader definitions.limits: After 120000 direct simple-cycle visits, separate the meeting blocks and solve the move and cycle equations on each. Enumerate the remaining supports within a block of dimension at most 15, with a fallback to direct cycles. Each residual cover search has 120000 visits, with at most 16 dimensions after restricting forced sums to unread carriers. An incomplete search is counted separately.
